name: Heightened Geas Trap (CR 10)
body:
Heightened Geas Trap
CR 10

Type magical; Perception DC 34; Disable Device DC 34

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset none
Effect spell (heightened geas [affected creature must report the attempted theft], 17th-level cleric, DC 24 Will negates)

The object in the statue’s hand is protected by a powerful spell which targets any non-good aligned creature that touches it to a geas spell, heightened to 9th level, which compels the creature to report the attempted theft immediately.
